incidents.short_description: Compute cluster degradation – Hartwell Financial Group workloads
incidents.description: Extended compute cluster degradation affecting Hartwell Financial Group production workloads on cluster vlt-compute-east-4. Incident duration: 4 hours 37 minutes (2026-04-22 21:47 UTC through 2026-04-23 02:24 UTC). SLA threshold breached per §5.1 of customer MSA. Customer filed formal credit request on 2026-04-25. Credit amount pending VP of Support authorization. See signed authorization form (sla_credit_authorization) for final approved credit figure. Incident root cause: firmware regression in storage controller batch VLT-FW-2026-04-19.

incidents.short_description: Network latency spike – Cobalt Systems Ltd region us-west-2
incidents.description: Transient network latency spike affecting Cobalt Systems Ltd workloads in us-west-2 region. Duration 11 minutes. Below SLA threshold. No credit applicable.

incidents.short_description: Billing export pipeline delay – Q2 close
incidents.description: Q2 billing export pipeline stalled for 35 minutes due to upstream dependency timeout. Resolved by on-call engineer. No customer impact.
